decision.scope: Only as one rigid open-top plastic crate appearance mode within the broad LOCO small_load_carrier class.
decision.reason: The blue crate resembles the rigid red tote examples, but the six train-only observations also include shallow black bins, yellow trays, dense stacked/nested crates and tall collapsible carriers that one blue asset does not cover.
decision.label_scope_note: A supported asset may be labeled as a small_load_carrier subtype without representing every appearance in the broad real class. Class-wide appearance coverage is a domain-gap measurement, not a requirement to reproduce every subtype before a limited baseline.

observed_real_variation: Rigid red open-top totes with handholds and labels appear close to the blue-crate geometry.
The class also includes shallow black bins, yellow shallow trays, tall red collapsible lattice carriers, and dense rack or pallet stacks.
Object count ranges from2 to168 in the selected images; close objects can fill over14% of the image while distant boxes fall below0.01%.
Observed backgrounds include worktables, people, racks, pallets, pallet trucks, shrink-wrapped loads, labels and long warehouse aisles.
Occlusion, truncation, nesting, stacking, repeated texture and very small distant instances are common in the selected examples.

synthetic_302.visual_conditions: clean light-gray floor/background, one blue rigid crate asset, one to three crates per image, no racks, stacking, nesting, labels, people or warehouse clutter

coverage_gaps_before_512.needed: Add or explicitly exclude shallow trays/bins and tall collapsible carriers; do not make crate_blue_a02 represent the entire class.
Include isolated, shelf, pallet/dolly, stacked, nested and dense repeated layouts, with a declared per-image count distribution.
Add small distant boxes, edge truncation, partial occlusion and overlaps; preserve bbox/semantic consistency checks.
Use racks, worktables, pallets, conveyors, labels, mixed packaging and warehouse lighting instead of an empty neutral floor only.
Vary red/blue/black/yellow/gray colors, surface wear, labels and materials without changing the target object boundary.

pilot_gate.next_small_step: Use a declared limited-appearance baseline with existing gray shallow and blue rigid crates; add stacking, occlusion, scale and warehouse background variation before rendering. Keep unsupported shapes as an explicit domain gap; do not add a requirement for complete class appearance coverage.

selection.scope: Six train-only LOCO examples from sub2/sub5 plus two existing302 synthetic reference views; sub1 test not opened
selection.selection_rule: Per split: large-object low-count, maximum-count dense, and smallest-median-area small-load-carrier examples selected before visual review.
